title: Table 1.1a Outdoor living area provisions: minimum area (single houses R2-R40)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Minimum OLA area by coding. The other Table 1.1a columns are constants carried by the rules: 65% of the required area without permanent roof cover (C1.1.1-r2), 4 m minimum dimension (C1.1.1-r1), behind the street setback area unless C1.1.2 (C1.1.1-r3). Same values as current Table B. On the page the location cell is merged across all rows including R2-R15, so C1.1.1-r3 applies R2-R40.
